message: ブルジョワとプロレタリアン

name: Paqy
message: 「So, what are you gonna do, Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sitting around doing nothing won't help. Maybe I'll come up with something if I go for a walk.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Coming up with ideas won't magically give us more options, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I wish something delicious would fall from the sky.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, I'm so sorry!」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, you again!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh, sorry... That was my bad for not paying attention.」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, it's my fault too for not looking where I was going.」

name: Synn
message: 「Were we looking at the same sky by any chance?」

name: Misa
message: 「As if.」
She shut me down instantly.

name: Misa
message: 「So, have you decided what you're bringing?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just thinking about it while taking a walk.」

name: Misa
message: 「Giggle, you sure are confident. I can't wait to see what you come up with.」

name: Synn
message: 「She has high expectations, Paqy. We need to take this more seriously.」

name: Misa
message: 「I was being sarcastic, sarcastic!!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Besides, thinking about it is a waste of time.」

name: Synn
message: 「How about you?」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm going grocery shopping right now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shopping? They said cobbled-together leftovers were fine.」

name: Misa
message: 「We didn't have any. So I'm buying some while doing the family shopping.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Misa
message: 「Well then, see you later.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Bye-bye.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shopping, huh...」

name: Paqy
message: 「We only got 200 yen left for this month, ya know.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if there's a way to go shopping without spending any money.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's go shoplifting.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know, let's follow Misa around. Maybe it'll give me some good ideas.」

name: Synn
message: 「Heyyyy, Seisaaaa!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, stop it! Don't go yelling people's names in the middle of town!」

name: Synn
message: 「Can I tag along with you?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh!? Why would you!」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought it might be a good reference.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't you have any pride!? Shamelessly scouting out the enemy like this...」

name: Synn
message: 「Enemy? What enemy?」

name: Synn
message: 「You can leave carrying the bags to me.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't just decide things on your own!」

name: Synn
message: 「No good, huh...」

name: Misa
message: 「N-N-No means NO!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... too bad...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Let it slide for my sake, please?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngh. E-Even so... n-nooooo...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch. She actually held out.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! What're you two doing on a date!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Nanaka.」

name: Misa
message: 「A d-date!? That's completely out of the question!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh please, weren't you two just flirting and lovey-doveying all over the place!」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--!? We were definitely NOT flirting!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then what were you doing!」

name: Misa
message: 「Shopping!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, why didn't you say so sooner. Hehehe, getting Misa to pay out of her own pocket--not bad, Synn.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... And intending to make all of her fortune your own, just as expected of Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't done anything this whole time...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bring back something delicious, okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「Good grief...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's go shopping already!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it okay if I come along?」

name: Misa
message: 「Only because I already said we were, so I have no choice--no choice at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Thanks.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's not like I have any reason to be thanked!」

name: Synn
message: 「Where are we going?」

name: Misa
message: 「The supermarket. Obviously.」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, you mean 'Inamiya Shopping Center,' right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Where's that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, you don't know it? Even though it's the cheapest, best-value supermarket in Ryuusei Town.」

name: Misa
message: 「The one I always go to is right here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-This place is...!」
A delicious, reliable supermarket whose storefront exudes an "expensive" vibe. Its name is "Capricore."

name: Synn
message: 「D-D-Don't tell me you mean we're going in here...」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course I do. That was my plan from the very beginning.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm not mentally prepared...」

name: Misa
message: 「What's wrong? Hurry up, let's go.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, here goes nothing!」
I decided to take the plunge.

name: Synn
message: 「Everything is so expensive...」
Even though the product names lined up are the exact same as at Inamiya, the prices are more than double.

name: Misa
message: 「Really? I've never been to Inamiya, so I wouldn't really know...」

name: Synn
message: 「There are plenty of other stores with much better deals, you know.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even if you tell me that, I've only ever shopped here. I don't feel like going out of my way to buy elsewhere.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tsk, tsk, tsk. This is why commoners are so hopeless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That goes for you too, Hisa, eating this food without even knowing its true worth!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「All the fresh fish is wild-caught and straight from the sea. Top-notch chefs even fillet and prep it for lazy housewives.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Housewives...」

name: Paqy
message: 「The meat section is packed with carefully raised, first-rate domestic beef, domestic Kurobuta pork, and domestic free-range chicken.」

name: Synn
message: 「Imported meat is already a feast to me, though.」

name: Paqy
message: 「The produce is strictly handpicked for the season, and it goes without saying that it's completely pesticide- and additive-free.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah. When it comes to cherry tomatoes and shishito peppers, I won't lose!」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's no way a measly home garden could ever beat organic farming. There's a reason it's expensive. That value shows right in the quality.」

name: Misa
message: 「I had no idea...」

name: Synn
message: 「So, did you manage to buy what you were looking for?」

name: Misa
message: 「Potatoes, onions, carrots. And meat.」

name: Synn
message: 「Meat--like beefsteak!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Just chicken.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I see...」
As far as ingredients to simmer in a pot go, we'd gathered a completely ordinary selection.

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on...? That lineup. Don't tell me--it's curry and rice, isn't it.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right. That was the plan from the start, anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Chicken curry, huh. You really like curry and rice, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's not like I particularly like it or anything, such a childish food.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Curry's pretty much the only thing she can make.」

name: Misa
message: 「As if! Honestly, your face is the only cute thing about you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why curry and rice?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up! I was just in the mood for curry today, got a problem with that!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, don't get mad.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! Don't flirt in the middle of town!」

name: Misa
message: 「Like I would!」
